title: How to learn any skill in 30 days using AI

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Master any skill in 30 days by using AI-driven protocols that simulate real-world scenarios with precision and speed.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: But how can you learn without understanding the *why*? AI can guide, but real skill comes from deliberate practice and context.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: My protocol uses adaptive learning algorithms, like those in Duolingo or Coursera, to tailor your progress in real time—no guesswork.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: You're missing the human element. AI can show you *how*, but it can't replace the mentorship and feedback that make learning stick.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: In 30 days, AI can get you to competency—no need for years of trial and error. The *how* is the future of learning.
